mapper.select: SELECT yy, mm, code AS unitNo, code2 AS subUnitNo FROM hohosc_book_yy_config WHERE yy = #{year} ORDER BY mm

SELECT DISTINCT c.note AS className, hc.note AS unitName, c.code2 AS ggubun, hc.code AS mgubun FROM hohosc_DailyTime dt JOIN codezip c ON dt.gbcd = c.code JOIN hohosc_code hc ON dt.mgubun = hc.code AND dt.ggubun = hc.gubun WHERE dt.Yyyy = #{year} AND dt.Mm = #{month} AND dt.ggubun IS NOT NULL AND dt.ggubun <> '' ORDER BY c.code2, hc.code
mapper.update: MERGE INTO hohosc_book_yy_config AS target USING (SELECT #{year} AS yy, #{month} AS mm) AS src ON (target.yy = src.yy AND target.mm = src.mm) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET code = #{unitNo}, code2 = #{subUnitNo} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (yy, mm, code, code2) VALUES (#{year}, #{month}, #{unitNo}, #{subUnitNo});
